name: B5-SL
description: B5-SL was a BB-series astromech droid with a black sensor and blue and brown paneling. Like all BB-series units manufactured by Industrial Automaton, it stood 0.67 meters tall. During First Order's occupation of the planet Batuu in 34 ABY, B5-SL spent time in a caged area of the Droid Depot in Batuu's Black Spire Outpost while the depot's owner, Mubo, ran a diagnostic scan on the droid.
